description: The bar chart illustrates the effect of different multilingual BERT models (mBERT-L2, XLM-L2, mBERT-R2, XLM-R2, mBERT-B2, XLM-B2) on various Indo-European language families (IE-Baltic, IE-Germanic, IE-Indic, IE-Romance, IE-Slavic, IE-other, Isolate, Semitic, Uralic) in terms of a specific metric, which is not explicitly labeled but is represented on the vertical axis. The horizontal axis lists the language families, and the vertical axis, labeled 'effect', has a linear scale with values ranging from 0 to 30. Each bar represents the effect of a model on a language family, with the height of the bar indicating the magnitude of the effect. The bars are color-coded to distinguish between the different models, and error bars are present on each bar, indicating the variability or confidence interval of the effect. The chart does not provide any information on the sorting of the bars or any visual emphasis on specific bars.
